card.name: Just before container nouns like tank, can, vial
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a container noun such as tank, can, bowl, silo or vial. Strongest on 'think' before 'tank' and on partial words that lead into 'vial' or 'container'.

modes.label: Think tank
modes.description: The word 'think' or '-t' just before 'tank(s)' in the phrase think tank.
modes.example: Telecommunications think<<-t>>anks with regional telecommunication associations will work

modes.label: Before a container
modes.description: A linking word or bracket just before a can, silo or similar container.

modes.label: Vial and container starts
modes.description: The first letters of 'vial' or 'container' in drug label storage and dispensing text.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict container words such as bucket, jar, bottle, tank and can.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to be a container, such as a tank, can, jar or vial.
